2608.06785.title: Multi-Perspective Triad Interaction Graph Neural Network for Cognitive Distortion Detection
2608.06785.paper_summary: Cognitive distortion detection is a key task in computational mental health, yet existing approaches often overlook the psychological structure of distorted thoughts. We propose MTI-GNN (Multi-Perspective Triad Interaction Graph Neural Network), which models Beck's cognitive triad---negative views of the self, world, and future---as complementary perspectives for classification. An LLM decomposes each utterance into the three perspectives, from which perspective-specific similarity graphs are constructed and encoded by a Multi-Perspective GNN. A Triad Interaction module models cross-perspective dependencies through sequential source-conditioned updates and feature-wise gating, while Prototype-Guided Perspective Fusion performs label-conditioned aggregation. Label-expanded supervision incorporates all available distortion annotations during training. We evaluate MTI-GNN on 9,764 samples from four Korean, English, and Chinese datasets spanning ten distortion categories. MTI-GNN significantly outperforms all supervised variants and exceeds eight prompted generative models under zero-shot and few-shot settings. Leave-one-perspective-out ablations show that all three perspectives contribute significantly, while human expert evaluation provides preliminary evidence of their alignment with the intended cognitive dimensions.
2608.06785.paper_summary_zh: 認知扭曲檢測是計算心理健康中的一項關鍵任務，然而現有的方法往往忽視了扭曲思想的心理結構。<lb/>我們提出了MTI-GNN（多視角三元互動圖神經網絡），它將貝克的認知三元組---對自我、世界和未來的負面看法---建模為分類的互補視角。<lb/>一個大型語言模型將每個話語分解為三個視角，從中構建特定視角的相似性圖，並由多視角GNN進行編碼。<lb/>三元互動模塊通過序列源條件更新和特徵級門控建模跨視角依賴性，而原型引導的視角融合則執行標籤條件聚合。<lb/>標籤擴展監督在訓練過程中納入所有可用的扭曲註釋。<lb/>我們在來自四個韓語、英語和中文數據集的9,764個樣本上評估MTI-GNN，這些數據集涵蓋十個扭曲類別。<lb/>MTI-GNN顯著超越了所有監督變體，並在零-shot和few-shot設置下超過了八個提示生成模型。<lb/>去除一個視角的消融實驗顯示，所有三個視角都有顯著貢獻，而人類專家的評估提供了它們與預期認知維度對齊的初步證據。
